name: dsh-multi-folder
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: secondary working directories for a project. The agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd, gains equal write/exec permissions on configured secondary directories under workspace-write mode, and is notified of configuration changes
readme:
# dsh-multi-folder

[English](README.md) | **中文**

> 为 DeepSeek Harness 项目提供**副工作目录**——不离开主工作区，同时编辑源码库、测试库与文档库。
